name: Matrouh Smart Government Services Complex data center component
notes: State Information Service reported the prime minister reviewed a proposed smart government services complex near the Olympic Village in Marsa Matrouh, including a data center covering base maps and regional layers; not a commercial colocation facility and MW not disclosed.

name: West Port Said Free Zone data center
developer: West Port Said Free Zone / WAVZ for Digital Transformation
notes: WAVZ states it is managing the data center of West Port Said Free Zone as part of the free zone digital infrastructure development project; capacity not disclosed.

name: Telecom Egypt Sohag East Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists Telecom Egypt's Sohag East Data Center at Labor Bureau - Sohag East; aggregate source, no power or space data disclosed.

name: Qareeb Data Centres Egypt Data Center - Gerga
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Qareeb Data Centres Egypt Data Center in Gerga, Sohag, as part of Qareeb's regional edge platform; exact operating status, city verification, and MW allocation are not confirmed in public primary materials.

name: Kemet Data Center - Sokhna Industrial Zone / SCZONE
developer: INTRO Technology / Intro Group; Oman Data Park
notes: EnterpriseAM, citing cabinet statements, says SCZONE signed a land usufruct agreement with Intro Group for a Sokhna Industrial Zone plot; project planned in four 20 MW phases, with full completion expected by end-2030. BusinessWire announced the original $450m MoU and 80,000 sqm site in SCZONE.

name: Government Data and Cloud Computing Center (P1) - Ain Sokhna highway
notes: Official State Information Service reported President El-Sisi inaugurated the Government Data and Cloud Computing Center in Ain Sokhna; DCD reports it spans more than 23,500 sqm with 10,000 sqm housing current infrastructure and remainder reserved for expansion. MW not disclosed.
